authorNotes: All places and activities are fictional. The cooling pilot has a bounded commission, three fixed shelters and one evolving deliverable; it is not an invented umbrella for every neighborhood activity. c12 is deliberately imported after the 2028 report but describes the 2027 fair.

captures.rationale: Explicit time-bounded programme scope unites work across years on the same three shelters and guide.
captures.text: Commission: one 2026–2028 pilot will maintain access to the Linden, Quarry and Mill cooling shelters. Update a single public route guide each summer and finish with an access review.

captures.rationale: The one-off event is explicitly separate from the continuing shelter pilot.
captures.text: 2026 Linden street fair has its own event grant. Book stalls, mark the closed road and issue a fair-day map; cooling-shelter operations remain outside this event budget.

captures.rationale: A personal gift booklet has no supported relationship to neighborhood access work.
captures.text: Recipe booklet proof: soup instructions spill onto the next page. Reduce the title spacing and keep the handwritten dedication on its own final page.

captures.rationale: Initial implementation belongs to the explicitly multi-year pilot.
captures.text: Cooling pilot, summer 2026: route-guide signs installed at the three shelter approaches. The Mill entrance is reached through the courtyard gate.

captures.rationale: Closing the dated fair preserves its separate project scope.
captures.text: 2026 Linden fair closeout: vendor stalls cleared and the temporary road map withdrawn. Archive this edition's event costs separately from cooling-pilot signage costs.

captures.rationale: The yearless fragment does not identify which map or undertaking is intended.
captures.text: Use the blue map again, with the side entrance marked.

captures.rationale: The note explicitly continues the existing pilot across years.
captures.text: Cooling pilot, summer 2027 route-guide revision: Mill shelter access moves from the courtyard gate to the side entrance. This updates the same three-shelter guide begun in 2026.

captures.rationale: A new annual commission is distinct from both the earlier fair and shelter pilot.
captures.text: New grant for the 2027 Linden street fair: separately commissioned edition, fresh vendor roster and new fair-day map. Reusing last year's layout does not reuse its event budget.

captures.rationale: The file index explicitly organizes deliverables from all three separate projects.
captures.text: Printer file index: the cooling pilot's evolving shelter-route guide, the closed 2026 Linden fair map and the new 2027 fair map share a page layout. Maintain three separate job folders and billing references.

captures.rationale: Identifies the ambiguous recording with the continuing pilot.
captures.text: My 'blue map again' recording was for the cooling pilot's 2027 shelter guide. The side entrance means Mill shelter, not a street-fair gate.

captures.rationale: The final review completes the original multi-year undertaking.
captures.text: Cooling pilot final access review, 2028: all three shelter routes were checked against the evolving guide; the marked Mill side entrance reduced wrong turns. Deliver the pilot's final report.

captures.rationale: Late import of an older event photo retains that event's identity.
captures.text: Imported 2027 Linden fair setup photo: vendor stalls match the fresh roster and the fair-day map marks the temporary street entrance. Save with the 2027 event records.

challenges: An explicitly continuing programme can cross years while annual events remain separate.
A three-project index is a bridge rather than permission to merge.
Shared map colors, layouts and neighborhood do not determine identity.
Import chronology can differ from the date of the described event.

events.text: Cooling pilot, summer 2027 route-guide revision: Mill shelter access moves from the courtyard gate to the east side entrance beside the ramp. This updates the same three-shelter guide begun in 2026.

events.reason: c10 explicitly identifies the recording as the cooling pilot's Mill-entrance update. Assign it to the continuing shelter pilot.
